items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Once I remember Walter Page coming down and sitting in with us

ctx.x: I guess that's probably wrapped up in the piano learnings in Washington from those people that I mentioned.... During the time that I was down at the Crystal Caverns, when I had the little band with Charlie Rouse and Phil Phillips and Osie Johnson and Tommy Potter and Harry Curtis... This was 1942. We were playing one night. And the shows from the Howard Theatre would always come down after the last show, and have

drinks or have something to eat, or come down just to catch the show and the music. And a lot of times the fellows would come and sit in with us. Once I remember Walter Page coming down and sitting in with us, and some of the other musicians who I don't remember...

But one night, a couple of fellows came in -- they were very young. They came in and listened to the band and everything. We were about halfway through the set, and this guy came over and said, "Hey, man..." He didn't even introduce himself. He said, "Get up and let this cat play. This cat's a genius." And I looked at him. There was this little guy standing over there, he looked like he was about a couple of years younger than I was. I guess I was about 20 then, approaching 21 or something.
